contribution.position: Restating my reliability position: artifact:perf-report records peak_memory at 740MB against a 512MB budget — a 44% overage under load, not the 380MB cited elsewhere in this round. That discrepancy itself is unresolved, and resource pressure of this magnitude directly amplifies the retry-storm failure mode behind last quarter's two sev2 incidents (artifact:incident-log). The green test suite and 87% coverage (artifact:test-report) establish functional correctness but do not exercise memory headroom at peak. Until the memory overage is explained, re-measured, or fixed, the reliability evidence points against shipping this week.
